title: Map
description: The map's areas and what tapping each one does (src/data/map.json). The pictures and tap shapes come from art/map/ (see docs/MAP_GUIDE.md).

back.description: The map the bottom-left button goes back to. Without it, that button closes the map.

id.description: Matches the 'area:<id>' layer in the map's Aseprite file.

name.description: The name on its sign. A journey place can leave it out to use the place's own name.

opens.description: What its button does: home, garden, meadow, friends, soon (not there yet), map:<map id> (another map) or journey:<place id> (the trip board, about that place).

unlock.description: Locked until this part of the game opens (see src/game/unlocks.ts).

lockedText.description: Said on the card while it's locked.

soonText.description: Said on the card of a 'soon' area.
